      Automatic backups

      Scheduled backups pause processes during the filesystem copy, then resume before upload. Running sessions stay open.

      Retention applies to automatic backups from this sandbox. Manual backups are kept.

      API access

      Sent as a bearer token to /api/v1. Leave empty when the server has no keys configured. Stored in this browser only.

      Base images

      What a new sandbox can start from. An image promoted from a snapshot is shared with every daemon on this deployment's cloud storage; removing it here removes it everywhere, and frees the snapshot it was built on for deletion.
